96:1: Read in the name of your Rabb Who is the Creator
96:2: He created man from an alaq.
96:3: Read! Your Rabb is the Most Generous.
96:4: He who taught with the pen.
96:5: He taught man what he did not know.
96:8: Surely the return is to your Rabb.
96:9: Have you seen the one who forbids
96:11: Have you seen, if he is upon guidance
96:13: Have you seen, if he denied and turned away.
96:14: Does he not know that Allah sees?
96:15: No, if he does not desist, we will surely drag him by his forelock.
96:16: We will seize by his lying, sinful forelock.
96:17: Then let him call his council.
96:18: We too will call the Zabaniyah.
96:19: No, do not obey him, prostrate and draw near.
